chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Hilāl, from al-ʿAlāʾ, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام gave judgment concerning a woman who committed zina and fled, that the Imam of the Muslims should bind her to the husband just as a runaway camel is bound with a hobble.

key_terms.إِمَامُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ: the leader with authority over the Muslims who enforces the ruling
key_terms.الْعِقَالِ: a hobble or binding rope used to restrain
key_terms.قَضَى: gave judgment; issued a legal ruling

ai.seo_question: What was the ruling of Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام regarding a woman who committed zina and fled?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal ruling of Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام concerning a woman who committed zina and absconded. It indicates the authority of the Imam in enforcing judicial rulings and uses the image of restraining a runaway camel to describe physically securing her to the husband.
